name: Neville's Haze
summary: Neville's Haze is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Green House Seed Co.|Green House Seeds]] from [[haze|Haze]] backcrossed with [[northern-lights-5|Northern Lights #5]], named in tribute to Nevil Schoenmakers. It won first place in the seed company division at the 1998 High Times Cannabis Cup. Green House credits its breeding to Shantibaba, who later left to co-found Mr. Nice.
